name: hooman
description: An agent skill for writing, editing and reviewing English prose in a plain style, with a checker and a fidelity comparison.

interface.longDescription: Writes, edits and reviews English prose in a plain style: facts first, an established document form and label headings. Includes a local checker, a comparison of an edit with its source and an optional editing helper that uses a second model.
defaultPrompt: Use human-writing to edit this draft.
Use human-writing to draft an update from these facts.
Use human-writing to review this prose without rewriting.
